scope: Apply the separately frozen corrected maturing-risk schedule to already-frozen external-wafer cashflows. No cashflow, growth, margin, turnover, reuse fraction, or program scale selected or changed in response to host prices. The host rate schedule and prices have now been observed.
limitations: A conditional success-case combination, not an expected value or forecast of a named customer.
Apply host rate to marginal program only for consistent sensitivity; a separate risky customer program may merit a different risk schedule.
No inference that broad source evidence establishes 10B Intel wafer sales or 40% sustainable incremental EBIT margin.
Initial reuse requires host-paid qualified capacity unused by internal production and no minority claim or opportunity cost.
Current host end-2026 value uses projected closing cash, whereas comparison quote is Nov4.
